title: Google\Cloud\Compute\V1\NetworkEndpointGroupCloudFunction
name: NetworkEndpointGroupCloudFunction
description: Configuration for a Cloud Function network endpoint group (NEG). The function must be provided explicitly or in the URL mask.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.function
params.description: A user-defined name of the Cloud Function. The function name is case-sensitive and must be 1-63 characters long. Example value: "func1".

params.name: data.url_mask
params.description: A template to parse function field from a request URL. URL mask allows for routing to multiple Cloud Functions without having to create multiple Network Endpoint Groups and backend services. For example, request URLs "mydomain.com/function1" and "mydomain.com/function2" can be backed by the same Serverless NEG with URL mask "/". The URL mask will parse them to { function = "function1" } and { function = "function2" } respectively.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: A user-defined name of the Cloud Function.

methods.name: setFunction
methods.description: A user-defined name of the Cloud Function.

methods.name: getUrlMask
methods.description: A template to parse function field from a request URL. URL mask allows for routing to multiple Cloud Functions without having to create multiple Network Endpoint Groups and backend services.

methods.name: setUrlMask
methods.description: A template to parse function field from a request URL. URL mask allows for routing to multiple Cloud Functions without having to create multiple Network Endpoint Groups and backend services.
